meta.name: diagnose-before-plan
meta.description: Diagnose failures before creating a Prime Agent plan. MUST USE for bugs, CI failures, test failures, regressions, incidents, broken behavior, root cause, RCA, or debug-why requests before deciding whether to plan; preserve language, reviewer, and criticizer settings in .git/optim-plans; exclude ordinary feature planning, direct implementation-only, factual/explanation, trivial command-only, or explicit no-plan requests.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 计划前先诊断故障根因
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果开发遇阻时总想先动手却找不准原因。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to identify root causes before committing to a plan.

howto.what: 装上后,遇到 bug 或失败类请求,Claude 会先查看日志、测试、报错等证据,给出根因摘要(最多 5 个 Why,证据不足会标 unknown),然后让你选择:制定修复计划、仅保留诊断、其他或自动完成。
howto.when: 当你提到 bug、测试失败、回归等需要查根因的请求时触发。

say.text: 帮我诊断这个 CI 失败,先别急着写计划。
say.note: 会先输出根因摘要,再询问下一步。

say.text: 这个测试为什么挂了?先做 RCA。
say.note: 按流程给出最多 5 个 Why 的根因分析。

say.text: 看看回归的原因,再决定要不要计划。
say.note: 先诊断,再让你选择是否制定修复计划。

howto.what_en: On bug or failure requests, Claude first inspects logs, tests, errors, and other evidence, produces an RCA summary (up to 5 Whys, or 'unknown' if insufficient), then asks you to choose: create fix plan, stop after RCA, other, or auto-complete.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you report bugs, test failures, regressions, or other root-cause/debug-why requests before planning.

say_en.text: Help me diagnose this CI failure; don't write a plan yet.
say_en.note: Outputs an RCA summary first, then asks next steps.

say_en.text: Why did this test fail? Do an RCA first.
say_en.note: Runs up to 5 Whys for root cause analysis.

say_en.text: Check the cause of this regression before deciding on a plan.
say_en.note: Diagnoses first, then lets you choose whether to plan.
